name: Opia
source:
It's your first date with Kira. Things are a little awkward at first with you waking up in her apartment tied to a chair, but we all have our mishaps. Let's hope it goes well!

[From [url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/opia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你和基拉的第一次约会。一开始，你在她的公寓里被绑在椅子上醒来，事情有点尴尬，但我们都有自己的不幸。希望一切顺利！

[来自[url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/opia]itch.io[/url]]
